tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Polish-run businesses outside Poland listed on Sami Swoi (samiswoi.app), for questions like "Polish plumber in London", "Polish shop in Utrecht", "Polish dentist in Oslo", "polska księgowa w Dublinie". Filters: country, city, category (slug or Polish word, see list_categories) and a phrase fr

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One Polish business abroad on Sami Swoi by its id or samiswoi.app page URL: category, city and country, address, website, languages, opening hours, short description and the data source. Phone and e-mail are on the linked page. / Profil jednej firmy.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries with Polish businesses listed on Sami Swoi: ISO code, Polish name, number of businesses and the country page. / Kraje i liczba polskich firm.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Business categories used by Sami Swoi (slug, Polish name, group, number of listed businesses) for the category filter of search_companies. Optional country limits the counts to one country. / Kategorie firm.
